title: HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.27233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open-set model), a domain-specific IMU foundation model that addresses both challenges through a two-stage training framework. translated_title: HALO：一种面向开放集人类活动识别的异构感知语言对齐IMU基础模型
translated_abstract: 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的人类活动识别（HAR）支持广泛应用，但该领域仍缺乏一个能够跨不同受试者、设备和活动进行泛化的统一模型。训练此类模型面临两大关键挑战：传感异构性（采样率、通道配置和传感器放置的差异）以及对未见活动和标签词汇的泛化能力差。我们提出了HALO（异构感知语言对齐开放集模型），这是一种特定领域的IMU基础模型，通过两阶段训练框架解决这两个挑战。第一阶段使用异构感知的自监督学习预训练IMU编码器，包括自适应池化标记化、通道独立特征提取和上下文传感器条件化（将自然语言传感器描述注入每个通道嵌入）。第二阶段将该IMU编码器与语言模型对齐，以支持开放集识别。
tldr: HALO通过两阶段训练（异构感知自监督预训练和语言对齐）构建了首个能同时处理传感异构性和开放集泛化的IMU基础模型，显著提升了跨设备、跨受试者及未知活动识别的能力。
en_tdlr: HALO introduces a two-stage training framework (heterogeneity-aware self-supervised pretraining and language alignment) to build the first IMU foundation model that jointly addresses sensing heterogeneity and open-set generalization, enhancing cross-device, cross-subject, and unseen activity recognition.
